2026-09-09.intro: Wondering what’s going up down the street? A local high school senior built
2026-09-09.text: to help neighbors follow development projects, catch up on local news, and find public meetings. He learned mapping tools and sought feedback from South Bay city planners along the way. It’s a thoughtful project from a young neighbor who wants more people to understand—and get involved in—the changes shaping their community.
